display.purpose: Hero h1 and contact band h2, weight 800, tight tracking.

body.purpose: Running copy and lead paragraphs at 16px+.

shadows.name: media-soft
shadows.purpose: Case screenshots only; dark theme uses rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35). Tiles carry no shadow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Settle animation, button press, image hover scale.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: 700ms ease-out, from opacity .35 / translateY(18px) / scale(.985) / blur(4px); stagger 0/70/140/210ms
motion.purpose: The single load moment for the hero bento; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; padding: 15px 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-ink, #12171a); color: var(--color-bg, #eef1f0); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ink, #12171a) 86%, #03a9d4); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #03a9d4; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary pill with hairline border, for navigation actions like Ver trabajos.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; padding: 15px 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-line, #dce1e2); color: var(--color-ink, #12171a); background: transparent; transition: border-color 200ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, #12171a); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #03a9d4; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-shot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 320px; height: 240px; background: var(--color-tile, #fff); border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-ink, #12171a); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-shot-img { flex: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dce1e2, #eef1f0); } .ds-cap { display: flex; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px 10px; padding: 14px 20px 16px; background: var(--color-tile, #fff); line-height: 1.3; } .ds-cap strong { font-weight: 700; } .ds-cap span { font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-muted, #535e64); }

narrative.overview:
A cool off-white board of white 24px tiles, ink text and real screenshots as tile fill. Few projects read as plenty because services, cases and contact all sit on one grid. It refuses the dark developer portfolio with a wall of thumbnails. The voice is plain and friendly; the structure does the persuading.

The logo's cyan-to-green gradient is the only saturated color and appears on exactly two surfaces. Everything else is neutral, so the gradient reads as the place to act or look. Light is the primary theme; a dark theme follows the system setting.
keyCharacteristics: One shape for actions (pill), one shape for surfaces (24px tile).
Geist Variable only; hierarchy comes from weight 800 headings with tight tracking.
One motion moment: the hero bento settles in on load.
No eyebrows, no italic headings, no decorative icons in headings.

rules.name: The Two Surfaces Rule
rules.body: The gradient appears only on the automation tile and the contact band. Never on headers, buttons, text or other tiles.

rules.name: The Ink Variant Rule
rules.body: Raw cyan and green are for fills, the focus ring and the logo mark. Colored text and icons use the Cyan Ink and Green Ink tokens.

rules.name: The Upright Rule
rules.body: Headings are never italic (font-style: normal on h1 to h3), always text-wrap: balance.

rules.name: The Flat Tile Rule
rules.body: Tiles never carry shadows. Only screenshots shown outside a tile get the soft shadow.

dos: Do use the label "Escríbeme" for every contact-intent button (header, hero, contact band).
Do keep the gradient on the automation tile and contact band only.
Do use 24px tiles, 999px pills and nothing in between for surfaces and actions.
Do gate hover transforms to fine pointers and keep motion to the single load settle.
Do use Cyan Ink and Green Ink for colored text and icons so contrast holds in both themes.
donts: Don't add eyebrows, kickers or small uppercase labels above headings.
Don't put shadows on tiles or gradients on buttons, text or headings.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a second button shape.
Don't replace real screenshots with illustration or generic icon art.
